model:
rachana: 1
sutra: oprisk-capital
version: 1
description: 
match: { kind: oprisk-capital, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: "Operational and non-financial risk · Operational-risk capital", id: "$.calcId" }
strip:
  - { label: "Entity", bind: "$.legalEntityName" }
  - { label: "Business indicator", bind: "$.bi", fmt: "compact" }
  - { label: "BI component", bind: "$.bic", fmt: "compact" }
  - { label: "ILM", bind: "$.ilm", fmt: "price2" }
  - { label: "Capital", bind: "$.capital", fmt: "compact", emphasis: true }
  - { label: "RWA", bind: "$.rwa", fmt: "compact" }
panels:
  - id: components
    kind: hbar
    title: "Business indicator components"
    key: "F2"
    rows: "$.components"
    label: "component"
    value: "amount"
    fmt: "compact"
  - id: losses
    kind: line
    title: "Annual losses (10 years)"
    area: right
    rows: "$.annualLosses"
    x: "year"
    y: "loss"
    fmt: "compact"
  - id: built
    kind: provenance
    title: "How this view was built"
  - id: refs
    kind: links
    title: "Linked entities"
    code: "REFS"
    area: right
keys: { F7: "link($.legalEntity, 'legal-entity')", F8: "impact", F9: "raw" }
